description: This file contains unit tests for the MacNodeRuntime class, focusing on its handleInvoke method and various commands such as system calls, camera listing, screen recording, and browser proxy interactions. It uses Swift testing frameworks and injects dependencies for testing different scenarios.

classes.name: MacNodeRuntime
classes.description: A class responsible for handling runtime commands and interactions within the Mac environment.

classes.name: FakeMainActorServices
classes.description: A mock implementation of main actor services used for testing screen recording and location functionalities.

methods.name: handleInvoke
methods.description: Handles incoming invocation requests and executes corresponding commands, returning a response object.

methods.name: recordScreen
methods.description: Simulates screen recording, produces a file URL and a boolean indicating audio presence.

methods.name: locationAuthorizationStatus
methods.description: Returns the current location authorization status.

methods.name: locationAccuracyAuthorization
methods.description: Returns the current location accuracy authorization.

methods.name: currentLocation
methods.description: Provides the current geographical location asynchronously.
